terrainDescription.en: Serengeti plains, Mount Kilimanjaro, tropical Zanzibar coastline

roadInfra.bollardStyle: No distinctively documented national style found — not a confirmed clue

utilityPole.transformerMount: No Tanzania-specific source found; inferred by regional analogy to Kenya's concrete/wood L-shaped-crossbar poles (shared East African Community infrastructure heritage) — lower confidence than other fields

historicalContext.zh: 史瓦希利語在坦尚尼亞被視為國族認同的核心語言，官方推廣程度高於肯亞。
historicalContext.en: Swahili plays an even stronger role in national identity here than in Kenya, with heavier official promotion.

note.zh: Kanga／Kitenge 布料同樣常見；尚吉巴因歷史上阿曼蘇丹國統治，服飾與建築帶有較明顯的阿拉伯/波斯灣影響（如門框雕花），是與肯亞沿海略有差異的弱線索。
note.en: Kanga/Kitenge cloth is common here too. Zanzibar, due to Omani Sultanate history, shows more visible Arab/Gulf influence in dress and architecture (e.g. carved door frames) — a weak differentiator from Kenya's coast.
